_notes: C6 - Sub-crew ('tables') capture, office half (catalog C6, plan test-plans/journey-c/c06-sub-crew-tables-capture.md, runner rows C6-001/C6-002). dayOffset -10 is Journey C's own fixture day, distinct from Journey B's 0...-9 block, so the two suites never collide on the same day's cards.

table.source 'fixture' (C6-002) targets the fixed 'C6 TABLE A' row from src/data/journey-c/fixture.json, ensured through the API and never deleted: GET /crew-tables/{id} answers 500 on dev (mssql: Invalid object name 'ct.TimeStamp'), so DELETE has no rowversion to send and a run-unique table would leak one row per run. C6-001 still mints a run-unique table on screen - that IS the workflow step - and declares it unremovable until the defect is fixed, then its cleanup step switches to 'delete'.

C6-002's capture clocks the three fixture table workers (7002-7004) in against the table and the fixture supervisor (7005) in with no table, so the roll-up partitions a non-trivial 3 on-table + 1 off-table = 4, not a trivial 3 = 3 / 0 off.

C6-003 (reopen a saved table from the grid, C6-R6) is not in this file: GET /crew-tables/{id} 500s on dev today, so the Edit page cannot be exercised. It is tracked in the runner CSV with enabled=0 until the defect is fixed.
